<窗口函数> OVER (PARTITION BY <用于分组的列名> ORDER BY <用于排序的列名>  ROWS BETWEEN ... AND ...)
<窗口函数> OVER (PARTITION BY <用于分组的列名> ORDER BY <用于排序的列名> RANGE BETWEEN ... AND ...)

SELECT * 
  FROM (SELECT `ename`
             , `sal`
             , ROW_NUMBER() over (ORDER BY `sal` DESC) AS `rk`
	      FROM `tb_emp`) AS `temp`
 WHERE `rk` between 4 and 6;
